description: nu 0.115: do { ^missing-cmd ... } | complete does NOT capture a spawn error when the external is not on PATH — the error escapes complete and only an outer try/catch sees it, silently skipping any fallback chain after the probe (observed in planner-preflight.nu probe-workflows-permission, run 01M32NGRSM8BCP0EGZTJS1WCDQ: the operator-marker fallback was unreachable while gh was absent). Wrap each probe in its own try/catch -> neutral verdict. Related: from json happily parses non-object payloads into scalars — guard record expectations with (describe | str starts-with record), since != record never matches detailed type strings like record<permissions: ...>.
resolution: Wrap each probe step in its own try/catch returning the neutral verdict, and use describe-prefix guards for record-shaped JSON.

description: Nushell command calls with bare (unparenthesized) arguments cannot span multiple lines — 'expect foo\n    (bar) true' fails with 'missing positional argument'; multiline continuations only work inside parens/brackets/pipes.
resolution: Keep each battery call on one line (run 01M35J62BSHH63XKTT34WP1SR3, .fabro/scripts/push-gate-fixtures.nu).
